# Lyrimuse

> Open-source Mac desktop lyrics, word by word, for Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube Music and eleven more players: on your desktop, in the notch or the menu bar.

Lyrimuse is an open-source (GPL-3.0) desktop lyrics app for macOS 14 and later, on Apple Silicon and Intel. It highlights lyrics word by word in a floating overlay, a capsule under the notch, the menu bar, the Touch Bar or a full Lyrics Window, for Apple Music, Spotify, Amazon Music, KKBOX, QQ Music, NetEase Cloud Music, Kugou Music, Soda Music, LX Music, reAMP, VOX, Pine Player, foobar2000, the YouTube Music app Kaset, and YouTube Music or Spotify Web playing in a browser. It scores fifteen lyric sources to pick the best match, shows translations and word-by-word readings (pinyin, Cantonese Jyutping, Japanese romaji, Korean romanization, plus readings for eighteen more languages such as Russian, Greek and Thai), scrobbles to Last.fm and ListenBrainz, can show what you play on Discord, and can put the lyrics on a phone, tablet or OBS through a browser. The interface is in English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French and German.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/privacy/): No account and no ads. Anonymous usage data never includes song titles, and you can turn it off. This page lists every server the app contacts, when, and what it sends. (also in [简体中文](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/zh/privacy/), [繁體中文](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/zh-Hant/privacy/), [日本語](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/ja/privacy/), [한국어](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/ko/privacy/), [Español](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/es/privacy/), [Français](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/fr/privacy/), [Deutsch](https://yudaotor.github.io/lyrimuse/de/privacy/))
